themes.name: Digital Civic Access
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve residents’ digital access to municipal services, public internet connectivity, or city information and data.

themes.name: Affordable and Efficient Housing
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they increase housing supply, improve housing affordability or transparency, or fund energy upgrades to homes.

themes.name: School Learning Support
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve school facilities, teaching conditions, meals, tutoring, class sizes, or educational enrichment for pupils.

themes.name: Public Transit Service
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they make bus and public-transit travel more frequent, available, trackable, or affordable for riders.

themes.name: Safe Streets and Cycling
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they use street design or traffic-calming infrastructure to protect pedestrians, cyclists, or schoolchildren from traffic.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they expand access to physical health care, mental-health treatment, preventive screening, or in-home care.

themes.name: Waste Reduction and Recycling
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they reduce disposable waste or create collection and recycling systems for recyclable or organic materials.

themes.name: Neighborhood Green Spaces
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they create or improve local parks, playgrounds, dog areas, community gardens, or street-tree greenery.

themes.name: Culture and Public Libraries
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they support public arts, cultural events, museum access, or neighborhood library services.

themes.name: Community Safety Services
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve crime prevention, neighborhood policing, emergency response, or safety lighting in public places.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Businesses
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they support workers, local hiring, freelancers, or small businesses through training, workspace, simplified licensing, or finance.
